name: Fall of Gyes
source:
The Fall of Gyes is a sci-fi visual novel from After Reset™ series with stunning cinematic quality and an intriguing story inspired by classic sci-fi horror films of Ridley Scott. If you like The Thing, Aliens or Prometheus movies with a claustrophobic atmosphere where no one knows exactly what is happening or who the enemy is until disaster strikes - then our kinetic novel is right for you.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/440100/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《盖斯的陨落》是After Reset™ 系列的科幻视觉小说，具有令人惊叹的电影品质和受雷德利·斯科特经典科幻恐怖电影启发的有趣故事。如果你喜欢《怪形》、《异形》或《普罗米修斯》等具有幽闭恐怖气氛的电影，在灾难发生之前没有人确切知道发生了什么或敌人是谁，那么我们的动态小说就适合你。

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/440100/]Steam[/url]]
